name: Citi Hopper
description: 100% Black women-owned, B-BBEE Level 1 transport and travel services company. 24/7 airport transfers, chauffeur hire, guided tours, and conference logistics. All rides carbon neutral at no extra cost. 4x ACSA Feather Award winner with 10.5M+ passengers safely transported.
location: Cape Town International Airport, Central Terminal Building

items.name: Shared Shuttle — City/V&A
items.description: Scheduled shared shuttle from Cape Town International to City Centre, Sea Point, or V&A Waterfront. Departs every 20-30 minutes.

items.name: Private Transfer — Sedan
items.description: Private Toyota Corolla or Avanza for 1-3 passengers. Direct, comfortable, and on your schedule.

items.name: Private Transfer — 9-Seater
items.description: Hyundai H1 for groups up to 9 passengers. Perfect for families or small teams.

items.name: Private Transfer — 13-Seater
items.description: Toyota Quantum for larger groups. Conference and event ready.

items.name: VIP Chauffeur — Lexus/BMW
items.description: Premium chauffeur-driven Lexus S250, BMW 3-Series, or Toyota Fortuner. Arrive in style.

items.name: 19-Seater Luxury Coach
items.description: Spacious coach with TV and reclining seats. Ideal for corporate groups and events.

items.name: Table Mountain Day Tour
items.description: Guided tour to the iconic Table Mountain with cable car access and panoramic views.

items.name: Cape Point & Peninsula
items.description: Full-day tour to Cape Point, Chapman's Peak Drive, Boulders Beach penguins, and Hout Bay.

items.name: Winelands Tour
items.description: Stellenbosch and Franschhoek wine tasting tour with estate visits and lunch.

items.name: Conference Transport
items.description: End-to-end transport logistics for conferences and events. Groups up to 750+.

items.name: Team Building Transport
items.description: Reliable group transport for team-building events across the Western Cape.

items.name: Car Rental
items.description: Self-drive vehicle hire with flexible packages for business and leisure.
